messages:
maria: heads-up — support escalated a repeat 429 + billing spike tied to short bursts. I'm trying to collect our internal load test notes to recommend sane RPM/TPM + burst defaults. anyone with recent runs?

liam: pulled staging run from earlier today. steady 100 RPM for 30m ok. then 10s spike to ~1000 RPM -> ~30% 429s and elevated p99 for surviving requests. rate-window counters hit and upstream worker backlog formed.

josh: support context: customer had many short-lived connections (serverless) and no keepalive, so concurrency estimate was way off and LB queued a bunch.

anita: repro i used (k6):
```
k6 run --duration 5m --vus 200 --rps 100 script.js
# then
k6 run --duration 30s --vus 500 --rps 1000 spike.js
```
spike.js fires many small POSTs. ran with per-key API token to hit per-key quotas.

maria: paste the quota config used? want to match prod defaults for parity.

anita: config I ran:
```
rate_window: 60s
per_key_rpm: 1000
per_key_burst_tokens: 200
global_rpm: 50000
per_route_multiplier: 1.0
```
we intentionally kept burst_tokens low to test protection.

liam: observed that burst tokens emptied almost instantly; after ~10s the rate_window enforcement started rejecting. because we refresh tokens discretely every 1s, we observed oscillation: brief allowances then hard rejections, which drove client retries.

josh: note: clients used exponential backoff with max_retries=8 and no jitter -> synchronized retry storms. we should recommend jitter + lower retry caps.

maria: billing spikes — support says some customers got billed even when many requests failed. currently we charge on receive, which means rejected requests still count. that's a separate convo but fuels complaints.

support-bot: @maria created ticket BF-372 for billing. invoice id 8812.

anita: we currently log token_consumed_on_receive and token_charged_on_completion. production charges on receive; recommend evaluating charge-on-completion or clearer docs about failures.

maria: for default RPM/TPM what should we set for a new PLG API key to avoid noisy neighbor but be friendly to small partners? propose RPM and 24h TPM.

liam: baseline suggestion: 600 RPM, 50k TPM (24h) with burst_tokens = 2x RPM (1200). also move to finer refill quanta (100ms) instead of 1s to reduce oscillation. enterprise keys get 5k RPM with SLA.

josh: +1, but cautious on burst_tokens. 2x seems reasonable. include guidance about connection pooling in docs.

anita: my load tests show <1% failures if burst_tokens >= 2x and clients use jittered backoff. with 1x burst_tokens failures jump to ~6-8%.

devex-ryan: i'll add quickstart snippet recommending keepalive, max_conns_per_host=50, and retry budget sample: max_retries=3, base_backoff=200ms, jitter=uniform(0,200ms).

maria: action items:
- liam: write short explainer on 100ms refill quanta and why it helps (ETA EOD)
- anita: run matrix: RPMs [200,600,1200], burst_tokens [1x,2x,3x], test pooled vs unpooled clients, record 95/99 latencies and 429 rates (ETA tomorrow)
- devex-ryan: update quickstart + retry guidance (ETA 2d)
- josh: follow up on BF-372 with billing to propose charging-on-completion or clearer docs (ETA next week)

liam: operational note — changing refill granularity requires migration of rate-window shard state. rollout plan: feature flag (rw-refill-ms) + phased enablement + canary region monitoring. I'll draft playbook.

anita: TLS session reuse in pooled client runs reduced worker CPU ~15%, which helps tail latency during bursts. include in docs.

maria: propose Console defaults: PLG keys -> 600 RPM, 1200 burst_tokens; opt-in higher burst for paid tiers. also expose a "burst_token_exhaustion_rate" metric (threshold default 30%) in Console.

josh: +1 on metric name and threshold. also consider alert when >30% keys exhausted in last 5m.

maria: i'll draft RFC and post to eng-architecture tomorrow. thanks all. tagging follow-ups: @liam @anita @devex-ryan @josh @support-bot :thumbsup:

sre-bot: deploy-gate note: feature flag rw-refill-ms created. do not enable in prod until playbook complete.

maria: saved. reconvene after anita's matrix runs. closing thread.
